annotation.title_clean: Le Gouvernement annonce la création de l'Institut national pour l'évaluation et la sécurité de l'intelligence artificielle (INESIA)
annotation.title_en: The Government announces the creation of the National Institute for the Evaluation and Security of Artificial Intelligence (INESIA)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique (France)
named_instruments_referenced: Seoul Declaration for Safe, Innovative and Inclusive AI
annotation.summary_en: French government press release of 31 January 2025 announcing INESIA, a national institute for AI evaluation and security, following the Seoul Declaration. It federates existing bodies (ANSSI, Inria, LNE, PEReN) without a new legal entity, steered by SGDSN and DGE, to build trust and safety tools for AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: INESIA created as a coordinating network without new legal structure
Federates ANSSI, Inria, LNE and PEReN
Steered by SGDSN and DGE (Ministry of Economy)
Follows the May 2024 Seoul Declaration on safe, innovative, inclusive AI
Innovation support to go together with anticipating AI risks and sharing good practice
